_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The score is coiling at the Anxiety/Complacency boundary with 97% of recent windows holding ±2 points, and without structural fuel recovery this lacks the thrust to resolve upward — HOLD is the statistically honest call until the breaker confirms.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing missing fuel and poor direction accuracy; narrative implies constructive accumulation but does not explicitly call direction, creating a split between caution and optimism
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 AND stablecoin growth turns positive AND funding cools below 45
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows stay pinned near 0 AND btc_momentum_30d reverses below 50 AND VIX spikes above 70
